name: lugus
description: Keep the rule next to the code it implements. Lugus turns natural-language rules into code, updates that code when the rule changes, and tells you when the two drift apart.

commands.title: Lugus: Link Selected Code to a Rule

enumDescriptions: Custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint (OpenRouter, Groq, LM Studio, DeepSeek, etc.)
lugus.provider.description: AI provider used for pseudocode translation.

lugus.model.description: Optional model override. Leave empty to use the default model for the selected provider.

lugus.baseUrl.description: Optional base URL override. Required when provider is set to 'custom'.

enumDescriptions: Keep the rule above the code with a fingerprinted end marker, so Lugus can detect drift and update the code when the rule changes.
Replace the pseudocode block directly with the generated code (one-shot).
Convert the pseudocode block into standard static comments above the generated code.
lugus.blockMode.description: Controls how Lugus writes translated code back into the editor.

lugus.enableCodeLens.description: Show block status and actions (Translate, Update Code, Accept, Detach) above Lugus rules.

lugus.contextLines.description: Number of surrounding lines (above and below) sent as local context. Set to 0 to disable.

lugus.languageOverride.description: Force a specific target language (leave empty to auto-detect from the active file).

lugus.timeoutMs.description: Request timeout in milliseconds. Local models may need more.

enumDescriptions: Show drifted blocks as warnings in the editor and the Problems panel.
Show drifted blocks as faint hints in the editor only.
Do not report drift as diagnostics (CodeLens still shows the status).
lugus.driftSeverity.description: How blocks whose rule and code no longer match are reported in the Problems panel.

scripts.build: npm run build:ext && npm run build:cli
scripts.test:smoke: npm run build:ext && esbuild src/core/blocks.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=out-test/smoke-core.js && node test/smoke/smoke.js dist/extension.js out-test/smoke-core.js
